nodes.label: Duplication report
nodes.rationale: Scan dated 2026-10-26 on branch refactor/structure. No functions were moved by the scan itself, and no request, response, or scheduling rule was changed. Steps 1 through 7 of the suggested extract were later marked done.

nodes.label: Keep call-site rules
nodes.rationale: A later extract must keep each call site's current rule. Several copies look alike and then differ on status values, active-row filters, or which faculty id they mean. Do not fold them into one function with one default.

nodes.label: Date and time parsing copies
nodes.rationale: HH:MM, ISO dates, ISO datetimes with a trailing Z, clock display including MySQL timedelta, 12-hour display, and weekday names were copied across timetable, faculty, student, admin, and API routes. The four format_time copies match except routes/students/student.py, which returns a string unchanged. safe_clock wraps a timedelta with modulo 86400. Callers keep their own error text. Display formats other than HH:MM stay at the call site.

nodes.label: utils/dates.py
nodes.rationale: Proposed home for parse_hhmm, parse_iso_date, format_hhmm, and weekday_name. Done: format_hhmm is shared and the old format_time names call it. The student route passes keep_string=True. safe_clock and the 12-hour filter were not changed. safe_clock stays on the /api allowlist.

nodes.label: Holiday check copies
nodes.rationale: Generation loads recurring days and dates inside the week. The manual add form only rejects a recurring holiday for that weekday and program and does not look up a calendar date. Create and edit uniqueness reject a second recurring row; the API also excludes the row being edited and the HTML form does not. The dashboard upcoming list is read-only and is not a scheduling rule. Do not make the manual add use the week query.

nodes.label: academic_rules/holidays.py
nodes.rationale: Home of holidays_for_week, recurring_holiday_blocks_day, and recurring_holiday_taken. Done: the generator week load, the manual weekday block, and recurring-holiday uniqueness call this module. The HTML uniqueness check keeps ignore_id=None.

nodes.label: Availability and absence copies
nodes.rationale: Generation blocks on an absence that date, a busy span already assigned in the run, or an overlapping is_available 0 window. A recorded shift window does not block a slot outside that shift. Manual add is stricter: if any availability row exists for that faculty and day, the slot must sit inside an is_available 1 window. Availability saves in admin and faculty routes delete existing rows and insert the submitted slots. One path commits the delete before the insert. Teacher absence inserts use status UNPROCESSED and session faculty_id, which is faculty.id. Admin absence inserts use status PROCESSED and the faculty id in the URL.

nodes.label: academic_rules/availability.py
nodes.rationale: Done: generation availability and the manual availability block call academic_rules/availability.py. A shift window still does not block generation. The manual form still requires a covering available window. Absence inserts stay in their routes until a signature carries the status.

nodes.label: Faculty id mismatch
nodes.rationale: The generator compares faculty_absences.faculty_id with faculty_allocations.faculty_id. Allocation faculty ids are user ids. Absence rows are stored with faculty.id on the teacher and admin forms. Leave that comparison where it is. Do not correct it while extracting.

nodes.label: Proxy assignment copies
nodes.rationale: find_and_assign_proxy inserts proxy_log with status only. _admin_find_and_assign_proxy inserts the same match and also sets approval_status APPROVED, approval_date, and approved_by. The free check under both is the same timetable overlap and does not filter is_active. Proxy inserts stay separate because the column lists differ.

nodes.label: Clash check copies
nodes.rationale: Python overlap is _times_overlap. SQL overlap uses NOT (end_time <= start OR start_time >= end). The predicate matches. The is_active filter does not. Manual timetable checks use COALESCE(is_active, 1) = 1. Proxy free checks do not filter is_active. A shared helper must take that filter as an argument supplied by the caller.

nodes.label: academic_rules/clashes.py
nodes.rationale: Home of times_overlap and timetable_slot_taken. Done: times_overlap and faculty_timetable_free live here. Proxy free checks pass active_only=False, so inactive timetable rows still block a proxy. The manual add and room-conflict queries were not moved. The generator still calls _times_overlap. Room assignment still builds its own conflict message in the route.

nodes.label: core/pagination.py
nodes.rationale: The old paginate helper builds SELECT COUNT(*) by cutting the query at the first FROM, which can pull ORDER BY or a subquery into the count. Page sizes differ: 10, 50, and 20/50/100. Done: page_bounds supplies offset and page count. Each list keeps its own count query and page size. Do not route the API student list through paginate, because that count rewrite can change totals and the API total is capped by safe_count. Attendance still uses at least one page and still clamps the requested page before the offset.

nodes.label: API JSON helpers
nodes.rationale: routes/api/responses.py json_ok and json_error already share the /api envelope: success plus data, or success plus error.code and error.message. Mobile _json_error returns success false and error as a string. Older admin and faculty JSON still returns jsonify directly and is not the /api envelope. Do not point those jsonify calls at json_ok. A later move of the /api helpers to core/responses.py was proposed with the same two signatures. The done list does not say that move happened.

nodes.label: Mobile response helpers
nodes.rationale: Leave /mobile-sync/v1 response helpers in the mobile package. This scan says there is no /api/v1 blueprint.

nodes.label: Permission check adapters
nodes.rationale: security.has_permission flashes and redirects to login. The branding local has_permission flashes and redirects to auth.dashboard and uses check_user_permission. routes/api/access.py permission_denied and allowed return 401 unauthorized, 403 forbidden, or 500 with the caller's code and message. Done: departments, courses, and rooms call permission_denied and allowed. Log lines and 500 messages stay as they were. The branding decorator still redirects somewhere else, so it stays a separate wrapper. Role gates that only check session role are not the same check and stay.

nodes.label: JSON and form validation
nodes.rationale: routes/api/access.py parsers required_text, optional_text, flag, iso_date, whole_number, optional_id, decimal_number, and body raise InputError. Departments and courses had local copies that raise their own input errors. Done: they translate required_text and optional_text into those errors. HTML forms in utils/forms.py use WTForms for login, registration, users, and invitations. Do not run WTForms and the JSON parsers through one function. A later move to core/validation.py would re-export the same names.

nodes.label: core/db.py transaction
nodes.rationale: The repeated shape is open a connection, commit on success, rollback in except, and close in finally. routes/api/access.py close is the only shared closer. Done: core/db.py transaction commits if the block finishes, rolls back if it raises, and does not close the connection. It is used by department, course, year, semester, batch, subject, allocation, and holiday saves and deletes, by room delete, and by branding init, update, and reset. The read after a year, batch, or holiday save stays outside the block. Student, faculty, account, shift, user, and room-save handlers still call commit() because some input-error paths do not roll back. Availability saves that commit a delete before the insert, and the timetable generator commits, were not wrapped. A wrapper that always committed once at the end would change those availability saves.

nodes.label: log_activity
nodes.rationale: log_activity already lives in security/__init__.py. Callers are login and logout, profile and password changes, user and role administration, report exports, and a few /api user and account writes. Catalog saves, holiday saves, timetable generation, attendance marking, and most faculty edits do not call it. An extract must not add log_activity calls, because that would insert new audit rows. No new module.

nodes.label: utils/uploads.py
nodes.rationale: save_uploaded_file does secure_filename, joins the path under static/, creates the directory, and saves. The caller passes the allowlist, prefix, and timestamp it already builds. Done: branding, profile, and mobile face images use it. Branding allows png, jpg, jpeg, gif, and svg. Profile allows png, jpg, jpeg, and gif. Mobile face images allow png, jpg, jpeg, and webp, use a UTC timestamp, and exclude gif and svg. The student CSV import stays in the students route and is not a static upload. Profile upload was still the HTML form and was not ported to /api by this scan.

nodes.label: core/exceptions.py
nodes.rationale: Done: AppError, NotFoundError, ForbiddenError, and UnavailableError. errors.py maps them with the same JSON envelope as json_error. Pages still use the React response. The CSRF handler is unchanged. Route input errors still return their own codes from the route.

nodes.label: routes/timetable_algorithm.py
nodes.rationale: Left in place until a later phase: slot building, scoring, and candidate selection. Clash and holiday helpers can be called from there later. The generator body moves only in the timetable split, function by function, with the old import left behind. This scan still describes generate_timetable_for_class and faculty_is_available in this module.

nodes.label: services/face embeddings
nodes.rationale: Face image decoding and embedding stay in services/face/. The mobile upload only saves a file.
